versions.changelog:
Initial release of 快手公开数据采集与竞品分析 (guaikei-kuaishou-ops-tool):

- Enables one-click collection of public Kuaishou data, supporting video search by keyword, creator post extraction, and video comment retrieval.
- Returns structured JSON suitable for topic research, competitor monitoring, and trend/pubic opinion analysis.
- No login required—operates safely on public data only.
- Highly configurable: supports bulk operations, export options, and flexible input parameters.
- Detailed usage and troubleshooting guidelines provided for seamless integration with research and operational workflows.
